mapper.sql: SELECT DATA.* FROM ( SELECT '' AS ROWFLAG, ROWNUM AS RNUM, COUNT(*) OVER() TOTAL_RECORDS, DATA.* FROM (
mapper.select: SELECT CO.COMPANY_CODE ,CO.COMPANY_NM ,CO.ECTMRK ,CO.PRESENTN_NO ,CO.RPRSNTV_NM ,CO.NATION_CODE ,CO.BIZRNO ,CO.ZIP ,CO.ADRES ,CO.TELNO_1 ,CO.FXNUM ,CO.EMAIL_ADRES ,CO.CSTBRKR ,CO.CSMHSE_CODE ,CO.ACNUTNO ,CO.BANK_CODE ,CO.UNIPASS_ID ,CO.UNIPASS_DOC_BOX_CODE ,CO.DRWBAK_SE_CODE ,CO.RTROACT_PD ,CO.REQREQY_CALC_MTH ,CO.PRIC_RQEST_TYPE FROM COMPANY CO WHERE CO.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE}

SELECT CU.COMPANY_CODE ,CU.CUSTOMER_CODE ,CU.REPRSNT_CUSTOMER_CODE ,CU.ECTMRK ,CU.ATTRIBUTE01 ,CU.RPRSNTV_NM ,CU.NATION_CODE ,FC01_GET_CODE_NM('NA',CU.NATION_CODE) NATION_NM ,CU.BIZRNO ,CU.ZIP ,CU.ADRES ,CU.TELNO_1 ,CU.TELNO_2 ,CU.FXNUM ,CU.EMAIL_ADRES ,CU.EXCL_AT ,CU.DELETE_DRCTR FROM CUSTOMER CU WHERE CU.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND CU.CUSTOMER_CODE = #{CUSTOMER_CODE}

SELECT VE.COMPANY_CODE ,VE.VENDOR_CODE ,VE.ECTMRK ,VE.VENDOR_NAME ,VE.RPRSNTV_NM ,VE.NATION_CODE ,FC01_GET_CODE_NM('NA',VE.NATION_CODE) NATION_NM ,VE.BIZRNO ,VE.ZIP ,VE.ADRES ,VE.TELNO_1 ,VE.TELNO_2 ,VE.FXNUM ,VE.EMAIL_ADRES ,VE.EXCL_AT ,VE.DELETE_DRCTR FROM VENDOR VE WHERE VE.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND VE.VENDOR_CODE = #{VENDOR_CODE}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO DRWBAK_LMTT_REGLTN DLR USING (SELECT #{COMPANY_CODE} COMPANY_CODE ,#{DRWBAK_LMTT_REGLTN} DRWBAK_LMTT_REGLTN ,#{HS_CODE} HS_CODE ,#{EFECT_BGNDE} EFECT_BGNDE ,#{EFECT_ENDDE} EFECT_ENDDE ,#{RM} RM FROM DUAL) PARA ON (DLR.COMPANY_CODE = PARA.COMPANY_CODE AND DLR.DRWBAK_LMTT_REGLTN = PARA.DRWBAK_LMTT_REGLTN AND DLR.HS_CODE = PARA.HS_CODE AND DLR.EFECT_BGNDE = PARA.EFECT_BGNDE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET DLR.EFECT_ENDDE = PARA.EFECT_ENDDE ,DLR.RM = PARA.RM WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (COMPANY_CODE ,DRWBAK_LMTT_REGLTN ,HS_CODE ,EFECT_BGNDE ,EFECT_ENDDE ,RM) VALUES(PARA.COMPANY_CODE ,PARA.DRWBAK_LMTT_REGLTN ,PARA.HS_CODE ,PARA.EFECT_BGNDE ,PARA.EFECT_ENDDE ,PARA.RM)
mapper.select:
SELECT A.COMPANY_CODE , C.COMPANY_NM AS COMPANY_NAME , A.ITEM_CODE , A.ITEM_NAME , A.ITEM_NAME_ENG , PRODUCT_CODE , SPEC , ASSETS_TYPE , HS_CODE , UNIT , WEIGHT , TO_CHAR(CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATE_DATE FROM ITEM_MST A INNER JOIN COMPANY C ON A.COMPANY_CODE = C.COMPANY_CODE WHERE 1=1 AND A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE}
AND A.ITEM_CODE LIKE #{SEARCH_ITEM_CODE}|| '%'
AND A.ITEM_NAME LIKE #{SEARCH_ITEM_NAME}|| '%'
AND A.ASSETS_TYPE LIKE #{SEARCH_ASSETS_TYPE}|| '%'
AND A.HS_CODE LIKE #{SEARCH_HS_CODE}|| '%'
ORDER BY A.COMPANY_CODE, A.ITEM_CODE
